notes.title: Yet Another Update
notes.notes:
Following this review by NekoJonez:
https://arpegi.wordpress.com/2023/05/29/first-impression-paws-of-coal-pc-steam-point-and-dig/

We decided to make the visual glitch he mentioned go away. That is it for now.

Also: You can finally ENTER / EXIT doors with the right click :)

Minor bugfixing also.

notes.title: Month 1 Update
notes.notes:
- Now "continue" opens up where you stopped in the game, and not where you saved
- Opening the Journal now locks movement as expected
- Removed "release 1.3." text on bottom for better immersion
- Messages stay longer so you can see what clues you got etc
- There is textual feedback that you saved when you click the save button

Small but QoL is important.

notes.title: Week 2 Update
notes.notes:
Added in this update are:
- autosave after each conversation
- hopefully fixed any issue with crashing (but if not - see above)
- multiple save load slots
- fixed main menu coloring where people thought some option was greyed out

Hopefully this helps with the experience!

notes.title: Week 1 Update
notes.notes:
This is fixed:
- Using the button added in the previous update (X to exit journal) now does not cause issues
- The extended ending text added in the previous update (what happened to Rowan) now does not cause both different texts on Rowans fate to appear

This is in the pipeline for later:
- Full mouse only mode (adding right-click for entering doors, double-click for shift key e.g. rolling)
- Tooltips and hotspots for easier exploration (to see where objects are)
- Autosave and more save/load slots

Let us know for any more ideas!

notes.title: Day Zero Update
notes.notes:
We fixed some grammar, added a few lines of explanation of what happens to people based on your decisions in the ending, fixed the Instructions screen, added an Exit Journal button, and fixed some smaller UX issues.
The biggest thing we changed is to make the change in which way to correctly fix the engine.
